preconditions.description: The number of hashtags n must be between 1 and 500,000.
Each hashtag must have a positive length.
The total length of all hashtags must not exceed 500,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the resulting hashtags separated by newlines.

postconditions.expression: all(result_hashtags[i] <= result_hashtags[i+1] for i in range(len(result_hashtags) - 1))
postconditions.description: The resulting hashtags must be in lexicographical order.

postconditions.expression: all(len(result_hashtags[i]) <= len(hashtags[i]) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each resulting hashtag must not be longer than the original hashtag.
